title: 第11章 妖兽的作用第12章 战徐浩
content_zh:
“嘎嘣咔嚓~”
一道道骨骼摩擦的声音从江平安身体里传出。
水潭之中，江平安身体正在诡异蠕动，像是体内有着虫子在游走。
身上释放着超过正常人的温度，水面升起雾气。
“喝！”
江平安从水里高高跃起，抬起拳头砸向岸边的大树。
只听见砰的一声，大树树干爆裂。
看着眼前纷飞的木屑，江平安还有些稚嫩的面孔上浮现出一抹错愕。
仅仅用了一天，他居然将《血气诀》第一层学会了！
虽说是吃了三颗血气丹，对修行有增幅作用。
但这也太快了吧？
难道《血气诀》很好学？
不对啊，根据他在城里打探的消息得知，五百名士兵中才能出一位掌握《血气诀》第一层的士兵。
如果《血气诀》很容易学习，军队中的中队长不可能那么少。
可如果不容易学，自己怎么一天就掌握了？
难道与自己是修士有关？
亦或者说，自己在体修方面，是个天才？
江平安不知道自己是什么情况，他没有老师，没有朋友，没有引路者，没人告诉他到底为什么。
不过，江平安很开心。
掌握了《血气诀》第一层，这就意味着现在不需要动用灵气，也能与普通的中队长硬碰硬了。

他没忘记之前在鹰叹山脉外，被那个男人一刀震断肌肉的恐怖力量。
江平安摸了摸自己的头，感觉这次突破让自己长高了不少，纤细的身体也有了肉感。
“如果父亲和母亲看到我现在这么高，一定很开心吧。”
想到这，江平安脸上浮现出笑容忽然消失，紧紧攥了一下拳头。
他缓缓吐出一口气，“还不够强，还不足以报仇。”
那群士兵绝对不会放过他，他也绝对不会放过那些逼死父母的士兵。
“咕噜噜~”
肚子里传来饥饿的声音。
刚才明明刚吃过东西的，现在居然又饿了。
听说练武的人饭量都很大，应该是武者是通过食物增加血气有关。
江平安走到正在炭烤的马肉前，扯下一块肉，开始进食。
星辰漫天，夜空碧蓝，森幽的树林之中，少年独自一个人坐在火堆面前，陪伴他的，只有那道摇曳的影子。
“唰~”
一只黑色猎豹突然从黑暗中钻出，向着江平安的脖子咬去。
江平安早就做好准备，抬起旁边的刀向着黑色猎豹砍去。
“叮当~”
刀身与猎豹的爪子碰撞，发出了钢铁碰撞的声音。
猎豹快速落在地上，双腿猛蹬，以极快的速度继续向着江平安脖子咬去。
江平安心头一凛，这猎豹的爪子竟然能够挡住他的刀！
自己可是练气三层的修士！

难道这就是妖兽？
以前父亲就说过，山上除了一些普通野兽外，还有一些特别强大的妖兽。
这些妖兽智慧比普通野兽高，而且力量、速度远超其他野兽。
这要是被这只猎豹咬到，那肯定完了！
content_en:
"Crack, click, click~"
The sound of bones rubbing together came from Jiang Ping'an's body.
In the pool, Jiang Ping'an's body was squirming strangely, as if there were insects swimming inside his body.
The temperature on the body is higher than that of a normal person, and mist rises from the water.
"Drink!"
Jiang Ping'an jumped high from the water, raised his fist and smashed it against the big tree on the shore.
Only a bang was heard, and the trunk of the big tree burst.
Looking at the sawdust flying in front of his eyes, Jiang Ping'an's still somewhat immature face showed a hint of astonishment.
In just one day, he actually learned the first level of "Blood Qi Jue"!
Even though I took three Blood Qi Pills, it had a boosting effect on my practice.
But is that too fast?
Is "Blood Qi Jue" easy to learn?
That's not right. According to the information he inquired about in the city, only one soldier out of five hundred can master the first level of "Blood Qi Jue".
If "Blood Qi Jue" was easy to learn, there wouldn't be so few squadron leaders in the army.
But if it’s not easy to learn, how can you master it in one day?
Could it be related to being a monk?
Or could you say that you are a genius in physical training?
Jiang Ping'an didn't know what was going on with him. He had no teachers, no friends, no guides, and no one told him why.
However, Jiang Pingan was very happy.
Mastering the first level of "Blood Qi Jue" means that you can now go head-to-head with ordinary squadron leaders without using spiritual energy.
He had not forgotten the terrifying power of breaking his muscles with a knife from that man outside the Yingtan Mountains.
Jiang Ping'an touched his head and felt that this breakthrough had made him grow a lot taller, and his slender body also had a voluptuous feel.
"My father and mother would be very happy if they saw that I am so tall now."
Thinking of this, the smile on Jiang Ping'an's face suddenly disappeared, and he clenched his fists tightly.
He exhaled slowly, "Not strong enough to take revenge."
Those soldiers would never let him go, and he would never let go of the soldiers who forced his parents to death.
"Gululu~"
There was a sound of hunger in my stomach.
He had clearly eaten just now, but now he was hungry again.
I heard that people who practice martial arts eat a lot. It may be because martial artists increase their blood energy through food.
Jiang Ping'an walked to the horse meat being grilled over charcoal, pulled off a piece of meat, and started eating.
Stars filled the sky, the night sky was blue, and in the deep woods, the young man sat alone in front of the fire, with only the swaying shadow accompanying him.
"Shua~"
A black cheetah suddenly emerged from the darkness and bit Jiang Pingan's neck.
Jiang Ping'an had already been prepared, raised the knife next to him and slashed at the black cheetah.
"Ding Dong~"
The blade collided with the cheetah's claws, making a sound of steel clashing.
The cheetah quickly landed on the ground, kicked off its legs fiercely, and continued to bite Jiang Pingan's neck at an extremely fast speed.
Jiang Ping'an was shocked. The cheetah's claws could actually block his knife!
He is a monk at the third level of Qi training!
Could this be a monster?
My father had said before that in addition to some ordinary beasts on the mountain, there were also some particularly powerful monsters.
These monster beasts are more intelligent than ordinary beasts, and their strength and speed are far superior to other beasts.
If this cheetah bites me, it will definitely be over!
